text:
Maria L: hey team - pushed a follow-up to #3421 that reworks error handling in the runtime path. main points: clearer transient vs permanent error classification, added retry backoff for drain failures, and tightened logging so we can tie traces to requests. PTAL when you have a sec: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/3421 :wave:

Jon R: reading now. quick q - does the retry backoff only apply to drain errors or also to model load timeouts?

Maria L: good call. backoff is only on drain errors here (we saw a high false-positive retry rate for model loads). I added a comment in the PR explaining the rationale. snippet:```diff
- retry_on_all = True
+ retry_on_drain = True  # only retry transient drain failures
```

Kevin T: can you add a unit test that simulates a drain timeout + KV cache eviction interaction? that was the flaky window we hit in staging.

Maria L: yep added unit + small e2e smoke that runs locally. test names: TestDrainRetry and SmokeDrainPath. CI passed on my branch: `ci/runtime-smoke — passed (2m 18s)`

deploy-bot: Canary slot requested: canary-2026-03-18T09:00Z for runtime-service, reserved by Maria L

Jon R: left two tiny nits inline (naming + one logging level). nothing functional.

Maria L: addressed the nits and pushed fixup (squash ready). also added a short note in CHANGELOG about behavior change and rollout guidance for Dedicated customers.

Sara P: skimmed the PR, tests look reasonable. one question: any perf impact on p95? did you run the quick load profile?

Maria L: ran a 10k-req smoke locally, p95 unchanged within noise (~+0.2ms). I added the perf snapshot to the PR (perf/snapshot-1769954321.json).

Kevin T: LGTM. thanks for the smoke and tests.

Jon R: lgtm from me after the logging level change (verified in the latest commit).

Sara P: ok from my side too, looks safe for canary. :+1:

Maria L: thanks all. can someone schedule the merge for Thu morning canary window? i don't want to block other rollouts.

Kevin T: I can slot it in Thu 09:00 PT if deploy-bot confirms availability.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: runtime-service will roll out PR #3421 to canary-2026-03-18T09:00Z. reminder: canary runs for 60m then auto-evaluate.

Maria L: perfect. i'll monitor logs and post a short postmortem if anything odd. thanks for the quick reviews everyone :heart:

Jon R: thanks! appreciate the follow-up and tests.

Maria L: PTAL -> marking as ready-to-merge after canary reservation. cheers.
